stories.sectionSubtitle: Listen to the experiences of farmers who integrated KHAAD BHARAT Biochar into their agricultural workflows.

items.name: Ramesh Kumar
items.summary: Saved immense pumping cost and achieved rich cotton yields verified by HAU Hisar trials.
items.story: Ramesh Kumar integrated KHAAD BHARAT Biochar into his 5-acre farm. Grounded in CCS HAU Hisar crop-yield trials, the soil moisture held during critical heat waves, allowing him to reduce diesel pump irrigation runs from twice a week to once every ten days. Cotton fiber density showed significant quality improvements.

items.name: Savitri Devi
items.impact: 20% higher yield, lower chemical fertilizer reliance
items.summary: Transformed dry sandy patches into fertile vegetable beds using CAZRI Jodhpur guidelines.
items.story: Savitri Devi manages a vegetable nursery. Following CAZRI Jodhpur trials for sandy soils, mixing biochar with organic manure allowed her sandy soil to retain vital nitrogen nutrients. She observed faster root development in saplings and decreased spending on chemical fertilizers.

items.name: Gurpreet Singh
items.impact: Enhanced soil carbon, reduced fertilizer run-off
items.summary: Prevented nutrient leaching in sandy potato soils verified by PAU Ludhiana trials.
items.story: Gurpreet realized his fertilizer spends were rising while soil yields plateaued. Guided by Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Ludhiana potato trials, adding KHAAD BHARAT Biochar created a porous carbon sponge that locked in soil nutrients. His potato tuber size remained uniform, commanding top prices.
